items.title: AI infrastructure stocks surge after strong earnings from CoreWeave, Supermicro
items.summary: AI infrastructure stocks jumped, with shares of AI server makers, optical-products companies, and neocloud providers moving higher.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Cisco, Coherent Are Earnings Movers Late After Nebius, Lumentum, CoreWeave Lead AI Rally
items.summary: AI stocks led the market Wednesday, fueled by Nebius, Lumentum, CoreWeave and Super Micro. Cisco and Coherent were earnings movers late.

items.title: Nokia, Celestica, and Applied Optoelectronics Rally After Lumentum Sparks Broad Optics Rally
items.summary: Lumentum's blowout earnings lit a fire under the entire optical networking sector, sending rivals surging despite having nothing new to report themselves. Here is what the synchronized rally reveals about where AI infrastructure money is flowing next.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 12: Stocks Edge Higher as Inflation Data Eases Fed Rate Pressure
items.summary: AI infrastructure demand and moderating inflation drove broad gains, though geopolitical tensions remain, today, Aug. 12, 2026.

items.title: SpaceX, Nebius, Palantir, Super Micro, Quantinuum, Wendy’s, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Nebius soared afted the so-called neocloud reports better-than-expected second-quarter results, while fellow neocloud company CoreWeave posted a narrower quarterly loss, sending the stock up sharply.

items.title: Coherent Stock Drops Despite Earnings Beat and Strong Outlook
items.summary: Coherent beat earnings and revenue estimates and offered a stronger-than-expected outlook as demand for its optical-networking technology grows with AI infrastructure.

items.title: Coherent posts a blowout Q4 and aggressive guidance, yet shares take a 5% haircut
items.summary: Coherent reported fourth-quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, with adjusted earnings per share of $1.74 beating the consensus estimate of $1.62 by $0.12. Revenue reached $2.05 billion, surpassing the $1.98 billion estimate and marking a 34% increase YoY.

items.title: Supermicro Soars On Report. Why Nvidia Is Also Rallying.
items.summary: Super Micro Computer's upbeat second-quarter earnings report provided a positive read-through for partner Nvidia.
